PROTEIN OVERNIGHT OATS
Serves 5

5 cups old-fashioned rolled oats
5 scoops vanilla protein powder
5 cups unsweetened almond milk
2 1/2 cups plain nonfat Greek yogurt
5 T chia seeds
2 1/2 c. blueberries

1. In each of 5 jars, stir together 1 cup rolled oats, 1 scoop protein powder and 1 cup almond milk.
2. Stir 1/2 cup Greek yogurt and 1 tablespoon chia seeds into each jar.
3. Top with the blueberries, cover and refrigerate overnight.
